title: Extended ideal along a morphism
statement:
Let $f\colon Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $i\colon V(\mathcal I)\hookrightarrow X$ for the closed subscheme cut out by $\mathcal I$, that is, the closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_{V(\mathcal I)})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is $\mathcal I$ [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme], and let $p\colon P=Y\times_XV(\mathcal I)\to Y$ be the first projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the *extended ideal* along $f$ by

$$
\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y:=\ker\bigl(p^\sharp\colon\mathcal O_Y\longrightarrow p_*\mathcal O_P\bigr)\subseteq\mathcal O_Y.
$$

mathlib_match.how: exact: lines 39-40 define I.comap f := (pullback.fst f I.subschemeι).ker. Rename Mathlib's X,Y to the statement's Y,X. IdealSheafData records a quasi-coherent ideal by its affine ideals (Basic.lean:65); subschemeι is its associated closed subscheme inclusion (Subscheme.lean:472). Hom.ker (Basic.lean:692) computes the kernel ideal, with the actual affine kernel formula Hom.ker_apply (Basic.lean:702) for quasi-compact morphisms. The projection here is a closed immersion: the subschemeι instance is ClosedImmersion.lean:94 and base-change stability is line 382; it is affine by line 151, hence quasi-compact. blueprint_update.statement:
For $f\colon Y\to X$ and a quasi-coherent ideal
$\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ with closed subscheme
$V(\mathcal I)\hookrightarrow X$, define $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y$ to be the
ideal sheaf of the closed subscheme

$$
Y\times_XV(\mathcal I)\hookrightarrow Y,
$$

that is, the kernel ideal of the first projection
$Y\times_XV(\mathcal I)\to Y$. Equivalently, it is the image ideal of the
composite $f^*\mathcal I\to f^*\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_Y$.
